items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She was up here the other day. She visited me. We’re old friends.

ctx.x: Yeah. Brian Forbes. We went around the country . . . around the city. He had press, and he had news people coming up to the hotel. I was giving parties for people, press. It’s big stuff. We did get Kim Stanley an Academy nomination for that, for an unknown film. At a certain point, Bob Thomas, who was doing the p.r. for me . . . Was it George? No, Bob is the guy with U.P.
